title.narrative: Initiative to support the Egyptian Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities (MoTA) in reviving the national nomination strategy for the UNESCO World Heritage List

description.narrative: The UNESCO Regional Office for Egypt and Sudan is spearheading an initiative to support the Egyptian Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities (MoTA) in reviving the national nomination strategy for the UNESCO World Heritage List. Focusing on Abydos, a site of profound historical, cultural, and spiritual significance, the project aims to overcome challenges in preservation, awareness, and site management. Abydos, recognized as the cult center of Osiris, stands as a testament to Egypt’s rich heritage, featuring iconic structures like the temples of Seti I and Ramses II and the Osirion. This initiative integrates advanced heritage management methodologies, capacity-building programs, and international collaborations to craft a comprehensive nomination dossier. By engaging local communities, international experts, and leveraging UNESCO's expertise, the project strives to ensure Abydos's preservation and recognition on the global stage.
